title: Pod Salt Nexus Cherry Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Cherry Lemonade Nic Salt captures the rich depth of ripe Cherries, lifted by the sparkle of citrus Lemonade. The Cherry note is bold yet rounded, offering a sweet, slightly tart berry character that melds with the bright, fizzy tang of Lemonade for a flavour that tastes fresh and lively from the very first draw. Crafted at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt blend is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable pod systems , vape pens , and starter vape kits . The nicotine salt formulation delivers fast absorption with a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, ensuring a smooth and consistent vape experience. As part of the Pod Salt Nexus line-up, Cherry Lemonade is one of many inventive flavour blends designed to deliver authentic taste and reliable performance. Pod Salt’s award-winning Nic Salt expertise ensures that every bottle brings lasting satisfaction and premium quality.
